snippet.title: Welcome to Chirpvenience
snippet.description:
Welcome to Chirpvenience! is a short visual novel set in a small-town convenience store, offering a cozy and humorous slice-of-life experience.

Players take on a one-week part-time job in the tranquil “Lark Town”, working at the Chirpvenience store. Throughout the week, you’ll interact with quirky coworkers and customers, while stocking shelves, handling checkout, chatting, and facing unexpected events—discovering warmth, humor, and the everyday charm of small-town life.
